To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the proposed interactive visual human+machine learning method is able to support users in finding hypotheses for the explanation of features in multivariate volumetric data and (2) it is able to do so in a computationally efficient way.

(1) we have developed an interactive visual analysis and human+machine learning approach to support the generation of hypotheses that explain features in volumetric data; (2) the approach combines the superior pattern recognition capabilities of humans with the search and processing power provided by computers; (3) the approach has been evaluated with respect to its search times and noise tolerance, and it has been applied to a real world problem from the automotive domain; (4) the approach has proven to be useful in practice,

(1) the integration of visual analysis and machine-learning techniques is a promising approach to support the generation of hypotheses for volumetric data; (2) the combination of visual analysis and automatic hypothesis search is feasible for large, complex data sets; (3) the integration of human and computer is beneficial to both the user as well as the computer, as it reduces the search space for the human and increases the search quality for the computer
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel way of combining interactive visual analysis with machine learning to support users in the insight generation process.
the integration of interactive visualization and machine learning in order to support the insight-generation process of the user.
the development of a visual analytics approach to support users in the generation of explanatory hypotheses in large, complex data sets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is able to find hypotheses that are not obvious to the user.
the combination of interactive visual analysis and automatic hypothesis finding is a very promising approach to assist the insight generation in complex data.
the proposed approach is a very promising first step in a direction of a human-computer symbiosis for data analysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of human and machine learning is a very powerful tool for the insight generation of complex data.
the proposed approach enables the user to interactively generate and analyze hypotheses in a visual and intuitive manner.
it combines interactive visual analysis and evolutionary machine learning to support insight generation in complex simulation data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of human and machine learning can be used to generate and validate new hypotheses.
the combination of human and machine intelligence can lead to a more efficient and successful exploration of complex data.
interactive visual analysis can benefit from the integration of machine learning.
